name: Blank
description: A fresh presentation: one Title slide with empty placeholders, titled Untitled presentation, in the Simple theme with no pictures (docs/DESIGN.md 7.3, 7.7). deck.create copies deck.json and slides/ into decks/<id> with a new id, title and revision 0 and an empty assets folder; the archetypes are the layout list of packages/schema/src/layouts.ts. The `brand` fields are the deployment's default kit when no default template names another (docs/PRODUCT.md 4.1, 4.3): the name every Reset and every default logo reads, and the appearance a new presentation opens in.
